snippet.title: Haifa - Official Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at Haifa, a detective-style gameplay with narrative storytelling, where players search richly illustrated environments for clues while helping characters hold onto hope in the face of uncertainty. Haifa combines hidden object mechanics with emotionally driven storytelling. Players follow five characters as they uncover mysteries, confront personal trauma, and try to hold onto the small things that make life worth living. Haifa is coming soon to Steam.
